apps/web/features/plugins/server/directo.reason: The directory install path writes an installation row without reading a recorded scan verdict for the pack it admits, so a directory entry installs on provenance alone. The fix is the same call the marketplace path now makes, from the function that resolves the entry.

apps/web/lib/services/plugin-lifecycle.t.reason: Rollback moves installations back to a version the catalogue previously served, which cleared the gate when it was published; refusing here would strand every install on the withdrawn version instead. It is an operator action recorded with its actor in plugin_registry_lifecycle_events.
